_comment: Retrieval lab stage 3 on CORE (infra/core/lab_stage3.sh): late interaction for the whole corpus. Copy to lab_stage3.json next to compose.yml to change it. The late model is the late slot of the RX580 service config (container path); expect_late_key/quant are assertions: the run stops if the service serves another late encoder. clients = concurrent encode clients against the one resident late llama-server (pilot 28.09: 1 client 44.8 units/s, 2 clients 64). The pack is served by rx580-retrieval when search.multivector_dir of rx580.json names the late artifact directory.
